model.name: Adding a child updates that node in place — the tree must not collapse or rebuild wholesale (MVC, expanded state survives)
model.description: Tron defect on 0.8.175 (via PO): adding a child to a folder causes a FULL TREE COLLAPSE + wholesale RERENDER instead of updating just that node in place — his words, far from MVC. Architecture violation, NOT a UX-polish item: the unit IS the MVC model, so adding a child should update THAT node children IN PLACE (controller mutates the model node, the view re-renders just that node via the ONE VIEW BUS); the tree must NOT collapse and must NOT rebuild wholesale; any expanded state must survive. User terms: when I add a folder the tree stays exactly where it was and only the folder I added into changes.
